An upper bound below the cut classifies the artifact as weak; at or above the cut it decides nothing and the opponent is unknown. Missing, stale and unknown all fail out of the strong cohort, never into it. Refresh procedure and the measured proxy bias: docs/RATINGS_REFRESH.md.
